payload_texts.rendered_payload:
Following up because my first attempt at the steps in this thread did not stick. I was trying to shrink iPhone System Data use on disk as described in the PSA, but halfway through the process my phone got stuck and I had to start over. These are the recovery steps that finally worked for me after support walked me through the fallback sequence.

1. Back up your device fully before doing anything else.
2. Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage and wait for it to fully load.
3. Offload the largest apps first, then restart.
4. Check System Data again after the restart — mine dropped significantly at this point.

Hope this helps anyone else who got stuck midway through the original PSA instructions.

```system

```
